test_title: PYST 4: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 28 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Arrange the passage correctly:
(1) He started driving.
(2) He selected the fastest route.
(3) He opened the map application.
(4) He entered his destination.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct sequence of the actions is based on logical progression and chronology.
 
• **Step 1:** He opened the map application (action starts with accessing the tool to plan the route).
 
• **Step 2:** He entered his destination (after opening the map application, the destination needs to be set).
 
• **Step 3:** He selected the fastest route (once the destination is entered, the fastest route is chosen from the options).
 
• **Step 4:** He started driving (the final step involves initiating the journey).
 
• The correct sequence is **3 - 4 - 2 - 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Logical Flow:** The actions follow a logical and sequential order to ensure efficiency and clarity in reaching the destination.
 
• **Use of Tools:** The map application is the central tool that guides the decision-making process before starting the journey.
 
• **Chronology:** The sequence ensures proper planning before execution, avoiding confusion or errors during the journey.

 

**Coherent Sequence After Rearrangement**:

"He opened the map application. He entered his destination. He selected the fastest route. He started driving."</div
